hero.description: Experience the magic of authentic Rajasthani heritage and contemporary bridal artistry. Handcrafted with 100% natural organic henna for deep, dark stains and unforgettable wedding memories.

about.bio1: Hello, I am Bhuvi Prajapat, the artist behind Bhuvi Mehandi in Udaipur. Rooted in the royal city of lakes and palaces, my passion is creating breathtaking henna that honors ancient Indian customs while complementing modern bridal elegance.
about.bio2: Every bridal design is drawn with patience, pure concentration, and organic Sojat henna freshly infused with pure essential oils. Whether you dream of a traditional Marwari Doli-Baraat story or contemporary fine-line lace, I am dedicated to making your bridal experience unforgettable.
about.heading: Where Mewari Tradition Meets Fine Bridal Couture.

reviews.name: Pooja Rathore
reviews.text: Bhuvi is an absolute magician! She drew our destination wedding story and hidden portraits so exquisitely on my hands. The stain on my wedding day was pitch dark and lasted for over 3 weeks. Highly recommend her to every Udaipur bride!

reviews.name: Ananya Singhal
reviews.role: Royal Wedding • The Oberoi Udaivilas, Udaipur
reviews.text: The patience and precision Bhuvi has is unmatched. She arrived on time at our resort, brought natural organic henna that smelled heavenly, and created the cleanest fine lines I've ever seen. Every single wedding guest was mesmerized!

reviews.name: Sneha Sharma
reviews.text: Booked Bhuvi for my engagement and then again for my sister's wedding group. Her designs are super modern, chic, and the color payoff is extraordinary. She is polite, gentle, and a true artist!

services.title: Bridal Mehndi
services.description: From delicate patterns to rich, full-hand artistry, every design is created to make your bridal look truly memorable.

services.title: Arebic Mehndi
services.description: Bold flowers and delicate leafy patterns come together in stunning Arebic mehndi designs, creating a stylish, elegant, and effortlessly graceful look.

services.title: Bharwa Rajasthani
services.description: Inspired by Rajasthan’s royal culture, this fully filled mehndi combines peacocks, elephants, jharokha place, florals, and intricate details for an elegant traditional look.

services.title: Designer Mehndi
services.description: Creative patterns, graceful florals, and intricate details come together in beautifully crafted designer mehndi.

services.title: Engagement & Sangeet
services.description: Chic, graceful, and photogenic designs crafted for bride-to-be, sisters, and close friends.

services.title: Baby Shower Mehndi
services.description: Gentle, festive motifs celebrating motherhood with special baby motifs, lotus, and blessings.
